[[Battlemaster Helm]] }} == Objectives == Venture into the Hateforge Quarry, and remove the Twilight Hammer presence within for Karfang in Karfang Hold. * [[Har'gesh Doomcaller]] slain ==Description== I know what it is the Warchief speaks, the Twilight Hammer has recently moved into the Hateforge Quarry, located just south of here. It is an annoyance that was eventually going to draw in more attention from our former masters, and was something we would need to deal with eventually, now I implore you to help us with it. We may have the strength to fight deep, but to stop the Twilight Hammer lurking deep within the Dark Iron clutches, requires covert strength, not brute strength. As Warleader, I ask you to remove the Twilight presence on my behalf. ==Rewards== You will be able to choose one of these rewards: * [[Blade of the Warleader]] * [[Obsidian Gem Choker]] * [[Battlemaster Helm]] You will also receive: * 4650 [[XP]] ==Progress== Has it been done? ==Completion== On behalf of everyone here, you have done us a great service in securing our future, entrance within the Horde means we may get out of this ashen wasteland eventually. I have seen much in my time on Outland, and in the Blackrock Mountain, but I look forward in what is to come, and for that you have my gratitude. ==Progression== {{Of New and Old}} ==Patch changes== {{Patch|1.16.1|note=Added.}}
